name: Zul'Gurub: Jin'do's shade detection ends when the Delusions vision ends
contract: Jin'do pairs the Delusions vision (2118511) with the Shade detection of Delusions of Jin'do (24306,
effect 2) on the cursed player. 24306 lasts longer than the vision, so the cursed player kept seeing
Shades after the vision ended (round-8 tester, 2026-11-15). spell_jindo_coa_delusions_vision removes
24306 when 2118511 is removed, by expiry or dispel alike. In a Jin'do fight the harness cannot read
24306 (see zul-gurub-jindo-delusions-invisibility-detect-9661), so the hero gets both auras out of
combat, where the leave-combat interrupt of 24306 never fires, and the vision is removed directly.

steps.label: Give the hero the Delusions vision
Give the hero the Shade detection
CONTROL: the hero carries the vision
CONTROL: the hero carries the Shade detection
CONTROL: the Shade detection stays while the vision lasts
DISCRIMINATING: the Shade detection ends with the vision
